title: Translate and beat · Level 1: A square that closes
brief: The class robot starts in the middle of a 2400 x 2400 mm floor facing +x (starts vary 10 mm and 2 degrees); the level fixes the robot. Drive a square of 400 mm sides that ends where it began. The closing error is the distance from the start to the end of the axle's middle, plus 2 mm per degree the heading differs. The run ends when the program ends, or at 60 s. 50 points for a closing error under 30 mm, plus 40 x min(1, 5 mm / error), plus 10 at or under par time. A run that does not draw every side (the axle's middle travels 90 % of the perimeter and each shape encloses 80 % of its area) scores 0. Pass: mean 60 or more over 5 runs, 4 of them closing within 30 mm (every side drawn). Par: 12 s.

score.run: if(trailLength >= 0.9 * perim & pieceArea_1 >= 0.8 * area1, let e = (pieceClose_1 + headW * pieceTurn_1) in round(if(e < closeMm, 50, 0) + if(e <= precMm, 40, 40 * precMm / e) + if(time <= par, 10, 0), 1), 0)

closes.value: count(r in runs: r.trailLength >= 0.9 * perim & r.pieceArea_1 >= 0.8 * area1 & (r.pieceClose_1 + headW * r.pieceTurn_1) <= closeMm)

sources.where: G5.1 Translate and beat, the challenge paragraph and the level table (level 1)
G4.1 Shape artist: every side drawn (90 % of the perimeter, 80 % of the area by the shoelace formula), a stop (still 0.9 s after first moving: 5 deg/s, 3 mm/s)
